name: rebecca

extraFields.label: NOTE
extraFields.value: Experiment was begging to be let out, dissolution complete

transcript:
• 00:00 – 00:15 [Heavy mechanical locks engage; containment pod seals and powers up]
• 00:16 – 00:32 PETER: Hello? Rebecca? Are you okay in there? Look, I'm going to be honest with you, this might hurt a lot. But everything is going to be okay, I promise. Just... don't worry about why you're in this pod, and why it's suddenly very... um... hot.
• 00:33 – 00:39 REBECCA: Peter, why did the glass lock? It's getting way too warm in here. Let me out! Help! Help!
• 00:39 – 00:50 PETER: Stay still, okay? The thermal coils are just calibrating. Your—your consciousness is going to transfer right over, just like Dr. Vance said. Don't bang on the glass, please. You're gonna hurt yourself.
• 00:50 – 00:57 REBECCA: No! No, it's burning! My skin feels like it's melting, Peter, please! Open the door, please!
• 00:57 – 01:07 PETER: Wait, wait a second. The temperature gauge isn't stopping. Why is it climbing past 400? Rebecca, hold on, I—I'm—I'm trying to override the lock. The manual release is jammed!
• 01:07 – 01:11 REBECCA: I... I can't feel my hands anymore. Everything's turning white.
• 01:12 – 01:21 PETER: Vitals are zero. Transfer to Shell 02, Frisk is complete. (sighs) God, I hate this job.

name: INCIDENT 48-B // SKELETAL REJECTION & CHAMBER BREACH

extraFields.label: NOTE
extraFields.value: DURING A ROUTINE VESSEL SYNCHRONIZATION TEST IN SECTOR 04, CONTAINMENT PRESSURE SPIKED BEYOND SAFE THRESHOLDS. AUDIO SENSORS CAPTURED SEVERE SKELETAL FRACTURING AND VOCAL DISTRESS BEFORE AN UNEXPLAINED 1.4-SECOND SIGNAL BLACKOUT AT 00:36. WHEN FEED RESUMED, MULTIPLE CONTAINMENT LOCKS FAILED SIMULTANEOUSLY. DR. VANCE ORDERED ALL PERSONNEL TO EVACUATE AND SEAL THE WING.

transcript:
[00:00 - 00:07] [Violent static surge; distant screaming and heavy mechanical distortion]
[00:08 - 00:18] [Sharp bone-cracking sounds echo over frantic screaming and chamber alarms]
[00:18 - 00:35] [Signal warps into low-frequency roar; muffled voices behind containment glass]
[00:36 - 00:37] [ABRUPT TAPE CUT — SIGNAL INTERRUPTED]
[00:38 - 01:01] [Audio feed snaps back online; escalating alarms, rapid bone-snapping impacts, and total system overload until cutoff]
